text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Arkane's growth + analytics teams pinged us. They're trialing semantic search and a rerank flow; traffic jumped noticeably this week.
jon_product: Nice. Do we know which endpoints/models they're hitting? embeddings or generation?
maria_cs: Mostly embeddings for search (batching calls) and our rerank endpoint for product lists. I can share a short log extract.
sam_se: I can run a quick enablement session for both teams. Need a sandbox token and a snapshot of their sample queries. Also: current plan cap is 250 req/min for them, might be tight.
lee_solutions: @alia_sales can we authorize a temporary rate bump and a short Dedicated trial for latency-sensitive reranks? Sales input needed before we change limits.
alia_sales: Arkane is open to evaluating Dedicated for production rerank. They're price-sensitive but value latency. I'll draft a one-month trial addendum and loop legal. Renewal sits in ~Q3 — huge expansion opportunity if the growth team adopts.
maria_cs: One snag — customer filed ticket #8421: they saw inconsistent rerank outputs with long contexts (some hallucinated titles). Captured example and user prompt.
sam_se: Reproduced the issue locally. Looks like prompt truncation + mixing system/template. Proposed fixes: force prefix caching + enforce max_context check. Quick patch to prompt template ready, will push today.
ops-bot: ALERT: Arkane usage spike: tokens +120% WoW, peak qps 4x usual, top model: rerank-v1. Threshold breached.
jon_product: Can we get a quick telemetry breakdown by team (growth vs analytics) and by endpoint? If growth is the driver we should prioritize scoping the enablement.
maria_cs: Sending CSV to thread. Growth accounts for ~65% of calls; analytics are mostly batched nightly jobs.
sam_se: For the workshop I propose: 30m architecture + 30m hands-on with their queries. Will include best-practices: batching, caching, and using prefix KV cache.
lee_solutions: I'll schedule an enablement and coordinate with infra to pre-provision burst capacity for the week of the trial.
alia_sales: Book the trial kickoff for Tue 3pm PST? I'll join and cover commercial terms.
maria_cs: Tue 3pm PST works. I'll DM Arkane to confirm and share pre-reads.
jon_product: Great. Action items: (1) Sam — push prompt template PR + triage ticket, (2) Lee — temp rate bump + provisioning, (3) Alia — trial addendum, (4) Maria — confirm kickoff and send pre-reads.
sam_se: On it. PR link: https://git.internal/r/arkane-prompt-fix (will update thread when merged).
ops-bot: NOTE: Rate limit change request queued (ref r-5529).
maria_cs: Small note for CS playbook: mark Arkane as "expansion likely" and flag to AE for Q3 renewal outreach.
alia_sales: Adding to pipeline. :thumbsup:
jon_product: Thanks team — let's try to keep responses short in thread. We'll sync in the kickoff.
_meta: generated for dataset: customer-success slack thread about cross-team adoption and throughput signals
